audit_type_description: verification-credit/logical-gap scan of the NR-03 Lean formalization claim (Type G)
catalog_claims: 'The immutable ten-export Lean proof (tree/f664d07.../nonnegative-and-positive-factorizations/NR-03/lean) covers the n = 7 counterexample contracts and negates the complete original universal question'
'The canonical Linux Comparator/default-kernel verification (actions/runs/34785341662/job/103799711659) and sandbox/rejection controls passed'
finding_detail: The catalog's verification credit for NR-03 exceeds what its own cited sources support. RESOLVED.md asserts 'Lean verified -- 2026-09-13' with 'canonical Linux Comparator/default-kernel verification ... passed', but the tree page at the exact commit it links (f664d07) states the opposite: 'This is a source-only candidate: it has not yet passed the authoritative Linux LeanCert/default-kernel/Comparator harness or independent final proof reviews' and 'It does not add to the Lean-verified count or change the existing Solved status.' The paper itself closes the door independently: 'No Lean verification was performed.' The 10 sorrys in Challenge.lean are by design (Comparator boundary); Solution.lean has none -- but zero sorrys in an unverified source tree is not verification. The route that dies is 'trust RESOLVED.md's Lean-verified credit for NR-03', not the factorization (Type-E gate PASS) and not the theorem.

lean_scan.challenge_lean_sorry_note: by design: the ten statement contracts retained as the Comparator boundary (per tree README)

open_followup: The GitHub Actions run 34785341662 cited by RESOLVED.md was not independently inspected (no browser in this audit). The tree page at the linked commit already characterizes the Linux diagnostic as bridge-only (six lightweight modules) and disavows it as establishing the complete graph, the ten exports, or a Comparator/default-kernel pass; a human click-through could confirm what that run actually checked.
paper_quote: This is informal AI-agent review, not external human peer review or formal verification. No Lean verification was performed.
paper_source: incoming/nla-nr03-holden.pdf, Sec. 'Scope, prior work, and review status'
tree_page_quotes: 'Challenge.lean intentionally retains the ten statement contracts as the Comparator boundary, so its bodies contain sorry. The active Solution.lean root supplies all ten corresponding theorem exports and contains no sorry, native_decide, or custom axiom token.'
'This is a source-only candidate: it has not yet passed the authoritative Linux LeanCert/default-kernel/Comparator harness or independent final proof reviews.'

'A separate bridge-only Linux diagnostic passed for the six lightweight modules; its receipt is retained in reviews/bridge-diagnostic/. That conditional result does not establish the complete graph, the ten public exports, or a Comparator/default-kernel pass.'
'It does not add to the Lean-verified count or change the existing Solved status.'
verdict_note: GAP, not BREAK: no lemma of the paper's proof route was falsified (Type-E exact-certificate gate PASS). Per doctrine, gates refute routes, not theorems: the mathematical claim rank+(C7) <= 127 stands on the verified certificate; what fails is the catalog's 'Lean verified' credit.
